title: Re-finalizing an already installed Git-history generation id is refused with InvalidInput
wanted_capability: Idempotent finalize for content-addressed Git-history generations. finalize_history_upload builds a fresh StoredHistorySourceV1 (state Ready, created_unix_secs now) and installs it with install_immutable_json, which deserializes the stored source.json and compares with PartialEq. Because the generation id pins producer, repo history, namespace, HEAD, and manifest digest, an unchanged HEAD re-derives the same id; once the generation dir exists its source.json always differs (earlier timestamp, and state possibly moved to Active or Superseded), so a second finalize fails with StoreRequestError::InvalidInput (422). Reached whenever the collector ready probe misses, for example after the generation was superseded. Wanted: treat an existing generation whose descriptor and manifest match as idempotent success, ignoring timestamp and lifecycle state. The provenance-import finalize path has the same pattern.
missing_primitive: Descriptor and manifest based idempotency for generation finalize, excluding mutable source.json fields
fallback_used: Manual removal of the superseded generation dir and the wedged upload record in the daemon pod.
evidence: crates/bbox-git-source-store/src/lib.rs::finalize_history_upload (StoredHistorySourceV1 with created_unix_secs now, installed via install_immutable_json)
crates/bbox-git-source-store/src/lib.rs::install_immutable_json (semantic PartialEq compare since 4c4ef90a, not byte compare)
crates/bbox-git-source/src/lib.rs::history_source_generation_id (id covers manifest_sha256, so same HEAD re-derives the same id)
A covered repo's git-history lane failed finalize on every collector pass for several days until the generation dir was removed by hand
notes: Triage correction: the original diagnosis (pretty vs compact serialization breaking a byte compare) does not match the code; install_immutable_json has compared deserialized values since it was added. The failing field is the per-install timestamp and lifecycle state in source.json. Paired with gap-9c91a9c0 in one issue.
resolution_note: Addressed by GitHub issue #17 / PR #93, merged as 31e3df4b and included in deployed commit 237007630ef5700a610550e0d3dabc610ad6f550. finalize_history_upload compares immutable generation identity, descriptor and manifest while preserving an existing source record across lifecycle states. refinalize_reuses_existing_generation_in_every_lifecycle_state and refinalize_refuses_immutable_conflicts cover reuse and conflict refusal.
